headline: Read your meter’s live telegrams
intro: EDL21 connects a smart meter over a serial port and turns its SML telegrams into Home Assistant sensors for household electricity readings.
highlights: Choose the serial port in the setup form; the integration prevents the same port from being configured twice.
The meter’s electricity ID links telegrams to the matching device, while new OBIS readings can add sensors as they arrive.
Track total and tariff energy alongside instantaneous power, voltage, current, frequency, and phase measurements when the meter reports them.
